theater: 上敘利亞奧龍特斯河谷

battle.name: 第十七次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 上敘利亞奧龍特斯河谷
battle.brief: 圖特摩斯三世在位末年發動的第十七次敘利亞遠征，約公元前1437至1436年，兵鋒指向奧龍特斯河谷的卡疊施與圖尼普，與以米坦尼為首的聯盟對峙。埃及步兵早已改用直刃雙鋒劍，埃及月牙劍此時主要作為法老威權的典禮佩兵與軍中儀仗，並出現在神廟與王陵的浮雕之中。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 本場戰爭的交戰方，一方是第十八王朝的埃及帝國，另一方是以米坦尼王國為核心、聯同圖尼普與卡疊施等北敘利亞城邦組成的聯軍。埃及方面由法老圖特摩斯三世親任全軍最高統帥，軍隊按神名編為師團，見於阿蒙師、賴師、塞特師、荷魯斯師與蒙圖師，各師團各有自己的旗幟與軍官；法老身邊設有維齊爾主管民政與軍需，另有「大隊長」與軍務監督率領先鋒與駐防將士。迦南與黎凡特一線由埃及任命的「居民長」與關塞守將管治，提魯關塞是三角洲與前線之間的關鍵節點。米坦尼是上美索不達米亞的胡里強權，首都瓦舒卡尼在幼發拉底河上游，其大王以附庸網控制北敘利亞：卡疊施位於奧龍特斯河中游，圖尼普在其南側的貝卡谷地，另有哈馬圖、阿勒拉赫與卡爾基米什等城邦列在聯軍名單上；邊境地帶的游牧沙蘇人部眾也常與聯軍合流。聯軍並非單一編制，而是以各城邦的步兵與弓手為骨幹，輔以少量輕車與外來雇傭兵。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Egyptian Empire of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a coalition built around the Mitanni kingdom, joined by the city-states of Tunip and Kadesh in northern Syria. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh Thutmose III himself held supreme command, and the army was organised into divisions named after gods — the Division of Amun, of Re, of Seth, of Horus and of Montu — each with its own standard and its own officers. A vizier handled civil administration and supply, while a Great Chief of the Army and an Overseer of the Army led the vanguard and the garrison troops. Canaan and the Levant were administered by Egyptian Residents and fortress commandants, with Tjaru on the northern edge of Sinai the hinge between the Delta and the forward line. Mitanni was the Hurrian great power of Upper Mesopotamia, its capital Washukanni lying on the upper Euphrates, and its Great King held the northern Levant together through a web of vassals: Kadesh stood on the middle Orontes, Tunip lay to its south in the Beqaa, and Hamath, Alalakh and Carchemish appear on the coalition lists, while nomadic Shasu bands in the border country often joined the coalition as well. The enemy was not a single unified force: its backbone was the infantry and the bowmen of the individual city-states, supported by a small number of light chariots and foreign mercenaries.
people: 核心人物是法老圖特摩斯三世（孟赫佩拉），他既是祭祀中的「真理之主」，也是全軍最高指揮官，遠征的部署、行軍序列與停戰時機都出自他本人。他的正妻麥特卡雷與王室其他成員隨軍的部分，在卡爾納克的壁畫與王陵繪畫中留有痕跡。文官方面，先後擔任維齊爾的阿赫摩斯、霍特普、傑胡提與那赫特等，主持遠征的糧秣與文書；被授予「全軍將軍」頭銜的梅涅克佩爾塞涅布，據記錄曾在圖特摩斯三世晚年出任軍務監督。留下自述的是一位「國王編年史抄寫員」，其牛津出土的石碑寫明他奉命把法老在北方的戰功抄錄成篇，並曾被派往庫斯國界採金，說明遠征並非只有戰鬥，也有系統的記錄與戰利品清點。軍中還有年輕的拉美西斯，日後他以阿拜多斯石碑自述曾隨法老北征，在軍中立下功勞。聯軍方面，米坦尼的大王與卡疊施、圖尼普的王公，多數只以城名留下，這本身說明這類戰爭的對手往往是城市與地方勢力，而沒有逐人的傳記留下來。
peopleEn: The central figure is the pharaoh Thutmose III (Menkheperre), who was at once the One Who Is Established in Truth in the temples and the supreme commander on the field; the deployment of the army, the order of march and the moment of standing fast were all his own decisions. His chief consort Maatkare and other members of the royal house appear in the Karnak reliefs and in the royal tomb paintings. On the civil side the viziers Ahmose, Hotep, Djehuty and Nakht in turn handled the grain and the paperwork of the expeditions, and Menkheperraseneb, who was granted the title of Generalissimo, is recorded as Overseer of the Army in the closing years of the reign. One man left an account of himself: the Scribe of the Annals, whose Oxford stela records that he was ordered to write down the king's deeds in the north and was also sent to the border of Kush to collect gold, which shows that a campaign was not only fighting but also systematic record-keeping and an accounting of booty. Ramesses was among the soldiers, and his later Abydos stela has him claiming to have campaigned with the king as a young man of the royal house. On the other side, the Great King of Mitanni and the princes of Kadesh and Tunip survive mostly as city names alone, which is itself a clue: the opponents of this war were cities and local powers rather than individuals with biographies of their own.
kits: 本卡的埃及月牙劍是外彎的單刃兵器，砍下去不必回抽，在古王國早期曾是埃及步兵的標準配備，但到第十八王朝，它作為戰鬥武器已經退場：野戰步兵改用直刃雙鋒的短劍，也就是後世稱為科普斯的形制，更適合直刺，也更適合在方陣中列隊揮動。月牙劍在新王國轉向幾種用途：它是法老典禮上的佩兵，出現在加冕、賽德節與神廟祭典的行列中；它是王權的符號，在神廟浮雕的擊敵場景與王陵壁畫裡，國王握月牙劍面對跪地的俘虜；它也留在王家近衛與儀仗隊的裝備中，作為軍階與忠誠的標記。同時這類單刃彎刃在黎凡特青銅器時代晚期的墓葬與窖藏中仍可見到，說明它並未完全從西亞消失，只是不再是陣亡士卒用來搏殺的兵器。與月牙劍同時在役的裝備還有很多：步兵以複合弓為主，配箭、長矛、斧與投擲棒，使用直徑約一米的圓盾，護身有青銅鱗甲與皮甲，軍中備有外來雇傭兵，例如舍爾登人與梅什韋什人。機動方面是輕型雙馬雙輪戰車，車輪僅六根輻條，另有更小型的輕車；攻城靠撞槌、斜坡與圍城工事，海上支援由尼羅河三角洲的船隊沿地中海北上，在加薩、提爾等地卸下糧水。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh in this card is a single-edged blade curved forward, so that a stroke does not have to be pulled back; it was standard Egyptian infantry equipment in the Old Kingdom, but by the Eighteenth Dynasty it had left the field of battle. The line infantry had gone over to the straight, double-edged short sword, the type later called the kopis, a shape better suited to the thrust and to the swing of a formed rank. The khopesh now served in other roles: it was the pharaoh's ceremonial weapon, carried in coronations, sed-festivals and temple ritual; it was an emblem of kingship, seen in temple scenes of the king smiting his enemies and in royal tomb paintings where the pharaoh grips a khopesh before a kneeling captive; and it remained in the equipment of the royal bodyguard and of parade detachments as a badge of rank and loyalty. Curved single-edged blades of the khopesh type can still be found in Late Bronze Age burials and hoards in the Levant, so the form had not vanished from western Asia — it had simply stopped being the weapon with which a fallen soldier fought. Much else was in service alongside it: composite bows with arrows, spears, axes and throwing sticks for the infantry; round shields about a metre across; bronze scale corselets and leather protection; foreign mercenaries such as the Sherden and the Meshwesh. For mobility there were light two-horse, two-wheeled chariots with six-spoked wheels, plus even smaller light chariots; siege work relied on battering rams, ramps and blockade works; and naval support carried grain and water from the Delta ports north along the Mediterranean to places such as Gaza and Tyre.
tactics: 圖特摩斯三世的北方遠征有固定的路線與季節：隊伍在埃及的旱季出發，避開冬季的暴雨與泥濘，由三角洲北口的渡口與碼頭集結，走北西奈的沙漠商路，經提魯關塞進入迦南，或沿海的維亞馬里斯路北上，並以海船把穀物與水運到加薩一帶的接應點，減少沙漠行軍的負擔。行軍編制上，法老本人與王家近衛居中，先鋒由弓兵與偵察隊組成，負責搜索水源、探明敵情，也會襲擊水井與穀倉以迫敵求戰；主力步兵在接近敵陣時展開成密集隊形，以箭雨與長矛牆維持陣線，戰車部隊集中在陣前，負責正面衝擊與追擊殘敵。攻城與野戰之外，外交與施壓同樣是打法：遠征的同時，維齊爾與各地官員向附庸諸王發出最後通牒，拒絕進貢者便遭到軍事的懲罰，愿意服從者只需交付金銀、馬匹與穀物。戰後通常有兩項固定程序：其一，劃定新的勢力界線並立碑，把當地王公的名字刻上界碑，讓邊界在地面上看得見；其二，記錄戰果與進貢清單，寫進卡爾納克的編年史，由專職的抄寫員抄錄成篇。這套程序讓每一場遠征同時是一次外交儀式與一次行政接管。
tacticsEn: Thutmose III's northern expeditions followed a fixed route and a fixed season. The column set out in the dry season of the Egyptian year, avoiding the winter storms and mud, mustering at the crossings and quays of the northern Delta and taking either the desert track across northern Sinai, past the fortress of Tjaru, into Canaan, or the coastal road known as the Via Maris, with sea transports bringing grain and water forward to relay points such as Gaza so as to lighten the burden of the desert march. In the order of march the pharaoh and his bodyguard held the centre, while the vanguard was formed of bowmen and scouting parties whose task was to search for water, find out the enemy's movements and to strike at wells and granaries in order to force a decision; the main infantry closed into a dense formation when it came up to the enemy, holding the line with a shower of arrows and a wall of spears, while the chariots were concentrated in front, to shock the enemy and to pursue the broken. Beside battle and siege there was a third method, diplomacy applied as pressure: while the army was abroad, the vizier and the provincial officials sent final ultimatums to the vassal princes, and refusal of tribute was answered by punitive expeditions, whereas submission cost only gold, silver, horses and grain. Two formal procedures closed a campaign. The first was the drawing of a new frontier, marked with stelae on which the names of the local princes were cut, so that the boundary was visible on the ground; the second was the recording of the results and of the tribute list, copied into the annals at Karnak by a professional scribe. Each expedition was therefore at once a military operation, a diplomatic ceremony and an administrative takeover.
data: 關於數字，可以確定的有幾項。第一是次數：《孟菲斯石碑》自述國王的敘利亞遠征多於任何一位法老，一般認為圖特摩斯三世在位期間先後發動十七次敘利亞遠征，其中前十年已打了十次，本卡這一場即是系列的最後一次，年代約為公元前1437至1436年，落在他的統治末段。第二是參與者：卡爾納克編年史在某一次遠征的進貢名單上，列出卡疊施、阿勒拉赫、圖尼普、卡爾基米什、埃馬爾等城邦的名號，不同抄本計數有出入，約在七位至十一位之間；進貢的項目包括白銀、黃金、馬匹、牛群、戰車、亞麻布、彩釉器與酒。第三是時間：一次典型的遠征自離開三角洲到回到埃及，歷時約三至四個月，與旱季的窗口吻合。第四是規模：史料沒有留下這一支軍隊的頭數，一般學者按新王國的野戰編制推測，出征兵力在數千人到一萬上下，而敵方聯軍的總數只會更大，因為它由多個城邦各自湊出。第五是距離：由三角洲到北西奈提魯關塞的沙路已有數百公里，再向北進入奧龍特斯河谷又是一段長途，戰車與輜重車在這樣的路上速度有限；至於月牙劍這類典禮兵器，則由專人攜帶，不佔運輸負荷。
dataEn: A few figures can be stated with confidence. The first is the number of campaigns: the Memphis stela has the king claim that his Syrian expeditions outnumbered those of any other pharaoh, and it is generally held that Thutmose III launched seventeen campaigns in Syria over the course of his reign, ten of them within the first ten years; the war in this card is the last of that series, dated about 1437–1436 BC, in the closing phase of his reign. The second is the number of participants: on the tribute list in the Karnak annals appear the names of Kadesh, Alalakh, Tunip, Carchemish, Emar and other city-states, and the counts differ between copies, running from about seven to eleven; the tribute itself consisted of silver, gold, horses, cattle, chariots, linen, faience and wine. The third figure is time: a typical expedition lasted about three to four months from the departure of the Delta to the return to Egypt, which matches the window of the dry season. The fourth is scale: no source gives the headcount of this army, and scholars working from the field organisation of the New Kingdom put an expeditionary force anywhere from several thousands to about ten thousand, while the coalition on the other side was certainly larger, since it was assembled city by city. The fifth is distance: the desert road from the Delta to the fortress of Tjaru in northern Sinai already ran for several hundred kilometres, and the march on into the valley of the Orontes added a long further stage, a pace at which chariots and baggage wagons moved slowly; ceremonial weapons such as the khopesh were carried by appointed keepers and added nothing to the transport burden.
cause: 打這場仗的原因，是北方的權力格局已經定型，埃及必須靠反覆的軍事展現來維持既有的附庸秩序。圖特摩斯三世即位時，米坦尼控制著上美索不達米亞與北敘利亞的大半，赫梯在西面壓住安納托利亞，卡疊施、圖尼普等城邦名義上臣服埃及，實則在兩強之間左右逢源；埃及在迦南與黎凡特的據點只靠居民長與關塞守軍維持，一旦北方盟友改變立場，沿海與內陸的通道便會斷開。因此每一次遠征都有年度性的理由：迫使諸王重複進貢、交換人質、確認界線，同時把主權的儀式重演一遍，讓地方看見法老的軍隊仍然能夠越過沙漠。這一場是第十七次，也是最後一次，它在系列中的位置決定了它的性質：不是開疆拓土的遠征，而是收束整條北線、為王朝的轉折做準備的行動，同時也讓後繼者看見北方邊界究竟能守到哪一步。王朝內部同樣需要這類遠征為國庫與神廟帶來進貢、戰俘與物資，用以維持賽德節與各處營造工程的開支。
causeEn: The reason for this war was that the pattern of power in the north had settled into place, and Egypt had to keep demonstrating military force in order to hold its existing order of vassalage together. When Thutmose III came to the throne, Mitanni controlled most of Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria, the Hittites pressed down from the west over Anatolia, and the city-states of Kadesh, Tunip and their neighbours, though nominally subject to Egypt, drifted between the two powers; Egypt's footholds in Canaan and the Levant rested on Residents and fortress garrisons alone, so the moment the northern allies changed sides the coastal and inland routes would be severed. Every expedition therefore had an annual logic to it: it forced the princes to repeat their tribute, to exchange hostages and to confirm the frontier, while the ritual of sovereignty was re-enacted so that the locals would see that the pharaoh's army could still cross the desert. This was the seventeenth and the last of them, and its place in the series determined its character: not a war of expansion, but a business of closing the northern line and preparing the dynasty for a turn, and of showing the successor where the northern frontier could actually be held. Inside the state, expeditions of this kind were needed to bring tribute, captives and goods into the treasury and the temples, to pay for the sed-festivals and the building works at Thebes.
impact: 十七次遠征累積下來的結果，是埃及帝國在第十八王朝達到版圖的頂點：從努比亞的金礦一路延伸到幼發拉底河上游，迦南與黎凡特的諸城在名義上成為陛下的附庸，每年的進貢把地中海東岸的財富變成神廟的供物。遠征的後果不只在戰場，還在制度與藝術上：統治者每年在北方的巡行被寫成序列的編年史，刻在卡爾納克的牆上，抄本保存至今；同一組被征服者排隊進貢的場面，畫在阿瓦里斯的宮殿壁畫與列赫米雷墓的壁畫中，成為新王國最著名的政治圖像之一。壓力也傳到了北方：米坦尼與赫梯不得不重新評估各自的聯盟，這種角力在後來阿瑪納時期的來往信件中仍然看得到。代價同樣清楚，每一次遠征都要消耗大量穀物、牲畜與役畜，遠離水源的行軍極易造成非戰鬥減員，而加薩與西奈的據點線越長，守備與補給的負擔越重。第十七次遠征之後，北方系列就此收束，此後王朝的重心轉向努比亞、內政與王室儀典，遠征的傳統在近三百年後才由第十九王朝重新拾起，並最終在卡疊石與拉美西斯二世正面撞擊。
impactEn: The cumulative result of the seventeen campaigns was that the Egyptian Empire reached the full extent of its map in the Eighteenth Dynasty: from the gold country of Nubia to the upper Euphrates, the cities of Canaan and the Levant became in name the vassals of His Majesty, and the annual tribute turned the wealth of the eastern Mediterranean into offerings for the temples. The consequences reached beyond the battlefield into institutions and art. The ruler's annual tour of the north was written as a series of annals cut into the walls of Karnak, copies of which survive; the same image of conquered peoples queueing with their tribute was painted on the palace frescoes at Avaris and in the tomb of Rekhmire, and became one of the best-known political images of the New Kingdom. The pressure was felt in the north as well: Mitanni and the Hittites were obliged to reappraise their alliances, and that rivalry is still visible in the Amarna correspondence. The cost was equally plain. Every expedition consumed grain, cattle and draught animals, and marching far from water was ruinous for the troops, while the line of posts from Gaza into Sinai grew longer and heavier to hold and supply. After the seventeenth campaign the northern series came to an end; the dynasty's attention turned to Nubia, to internal affairs and to the royal ritual, and the expeditionary tradition was not revived until the Nineteenth Dynasty nearly three centuries later, when it finally collided with Hatti at Kadesh under Ramesses II.
result: 打到最後，埃及並沒有佔領奧龍特斯河谷的城市，也沒有把圖尼普與卡疊施收進版圖；結果是它們恢復進貢與服從，重新承認法老的宗主權，埃及在北方的有效控制線仍止於北西奈的關塞與地中海沿岸的據點，遠到北方的地方事務依然由當地王公與米坦尼一方周旋。遠征隊按例在初冬前撤出，隊伍回到三角洲，這一場在形式上完成，沒有留下可以長久駐紮的據點。從系列來看，這是圖特摩斯三世十七次敘利亞遠征的最後一次，他晚年的注意力轉向努比亞的遠征、賽德節的循環與底比斯的營造，王朝的北方政策開始收縮。接位的阿蒙霍特普二世仍要應付迦南的麻煩，但大規模的北方遠征已不再成例；再往後，第十八王朝在阿肯那頓時期失去了對黎凡特的大部分控制，第十九王朝重新爭奪這條戰線，最終在同一條奧龍特斯河與幼發拉底河的山谷裡，拉美西斯二世與赫梯聯軍相遇，爆發出比圖特摩斯三世時代更激烈也更有破壞力的戰役。可以確定的是，這一場之後，埃及的北線維持了數十年安寧，直到帝國整體收縮時才被放棄。
resultEn: In the end Egypt occupied none of the cities of the Orontes valley and took neither Tunip nor Kadesh into its map. The result was that they resumed their tribute and their obedience and once more acknowledged the pharaoh's suzerainty, while Egypt's effective line of control in the north remained where it had always been: the fortress line in northern Sinai and the coastal posts, leaving local affairs in the far north to be negotiated between the local princes and the Mitanni side. The column withdrew before the winter as usual and returned to the Delta; the campaign was complete in form and left behind no post it could hold for long. Across the series this was the last of Thutmose III's seventeen Syrian campaigns. The closing years of his reign turned to Nubia, to the cycle of sed-festivals and to building at Thebes, and the northern policy of the dynasty began to contract. His successor Amenhotep II still had to deal with trouble in Canaan, but large northern expeditions were no longer the rule; later in the dynasty the Eighteenth lost most of its hold on the Levant under Akhenaten, and the Nineteenth Dynasty contested the same line again, meeting Hatti in the same valleys of the Orontes and the Euphrates in a war far more violent and far more destructive than anything Thutmose III had fought. What can be said with certainty is that after this campaign the northern line held for several decades, and was given up only when the empire contracted as a whole.
